description: A narrow, rain-wet street at night lit by neon lotus-flower signs in pink and yellow. Close up, a young man in a mustard shirt leans out of his three-wheeled taxi, shouting angrily and shaking his raised fist. The view pulls back and shows a young woman in a blue top and white trousers riding past on a mint-green bicycle with a basket, looking straight ahead and ignoring him. Street food stalls glow under strip lights behind her and the neon colours reflect in the wet road.
